text.name: layout_title
text.data: Long L2 / all motors at joints

text.name: layout_description
text.data: L2: 280 mm. All motors share their reducer/joint shafts. J4 rolls L3; J6 rolls the tool. No belts.

text.name: transmission_model
text.data: Coaxial reducers and local 1:1 parallel-shaft belts. No axis-redirection gears or paths crossing joints. Belt stiffness and tooth contact are not simulated.
